text: Après avoir été mené 2-0 à la mi-temps grâce à Elias Okafor et Marek Barros pour Harbour City, Seabrook Town a réussi un incroyable retour pour s’imposer 4-2. Seabrook a dominé le jeu avec plus de tirs (22 contre 10) et une possession à 53.4%, montrant leur style offensif basé sur des centres et du jeu large[#905][#975][#1104]. Kian Romano a marqué deux buts en toute fin de match (90+2' et 90+3'), profitant des contres rapides après récupération pour sceller la victoire[#1882][#1906]. Malgré la brillante prestation de Marek Barros (note 9.8, un but et deux passes décisives), Harbour City n’a pas réussi à garder son avance. Seabrook a su accélérer après le changement tactique à la 65e minute, pressant plus haut et jouant plus direct, ce qui a multiplié leurs occasions et permis de renverser la situation[#1361][#1448]. Un match marqué par un superbe suspense et une bonne dose de spectacle !

trace.output: Brief: full-match recap for fan audience in fr

- Seabrook Town won 4-2 despite trailing 2-0 early in the match [#905, #975, #1104].
- Kian Romano scored twice in stoppage time (90+2', 90+3') to secure the win for Seabrook Town [#1882, #1906].
- Marek Barros (Harbour City) had the highest rating of 9.8 with 1 goal and 2 assists, but his team couldn't hold the lead [player_of_the_match].
- Seabrook Town had better overall xG (3.48 vs 1.0), shots (22 vs 10), and possession (53.4% vs 46.6%) for the match [team_stats].
- Harbour City played with "patient short passing" 4-2-3-1 formation while Seabrook Town used a "wide, crossing play" 3-4-3 style [team_styles].

- Seabrook Town’s two late goals by Kian Romano (90+2', 90+3') came from quick transitions following regains, illustrating successful counter-attacks that exploited Harbour City’s higher pressing and direct play after their tactical change while chasing the game [#1882, #1906].
- Harbour City’s first goal (45') was the product of a prolonged, patient short-passing sequence involving 17 passes over nearly a minute, consistent with their 4-2-3-1 formation focusing on a patient build-up style led by creator Marek Barros providing a through assist [#905].
- Marek Barros’s second goal (47') came directly from a corner cross, reflecting Harbour City’s occasional set-piece threat despite their usual patient approach, incorporating crossing opportunities despite the higher volume of short passing overall [#975].
- Seabrook Town’s equaliser at 69' involved a quick three-pass move starting from a regain by Tariq Marlowe and a through ball assist, confirming their 3-4-3 formation with wide crossing play and more direct, pressing style after the tactical shift at 65', increasing line height and press intensity to drive attacking opportunities [#1448, #1361].
- The earlier Seabrook goal (53') was an immediate finish after a ball regain, highlighting moments of direct attacking from defensive wins, fitting their approach to press and regain high in advanced areas for quick attempts on goal [#1104].
